item.title: Learning Only What Valid Adapters Can Express: Subspace-Constrained Adaptation Against Fine-Tuning Poisoning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05300v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

参数高效微调（如LoRA）虽减少可更新参数量，但仍允许大量行为改变型更新，易被投毒目标函数利用，导致后门攻击或标签翻转等恶意行为。现有防御多依赖额外检测器或强假设，缺乏对适配器空间本质的结构性约束。

方法：子空间约束自适应

本文提出子空间约束适应（Subspace-Constrained Adaptation）：不从头学习适配器，而是将梯度更新严格限制在由可信任务适配器池（196个公开Flan-T5-large LoRA）主成分分析（PCA）估计出的低维共享子空间内。该子空间捕获跨任务的功能相关方向，显著压缩无效自由度。

关键发现

  • 结构冗余性：适配器中30–38%的权重范数在评估任务分布下冗余，功能内容高度集中于低维共享子空间（<128维）；
  • 鲁棒性优势：在干净分类任务上，128维子空间约束微调性能媲美全LoRA；面对定向标签翻转攻击，LoRA准确率暴跌至3–26%，而约束方法仍保持62–96% 准确率（覆盖池内任务）；
  • 天然拒斥能力：约束学习器无法拟合噪声/垃圾数据，其适应损失在清洁数据与垃圾数据间相差120倍，形成无需额外检测器的强OOD信号；
  • 抗自适应后门：面对在子空间内优化的攻击者，当目标行为远离池中已有模式时，攻击成功率从100%降至8%；当目标与池中常见行为重合时，成功率降至15%（即阻断率85%），结果与目标向量到池子空间的角距离呈一致趋势，暗示存在池相对的安全边界。

创新与权衡

本机制以峰值可塑性为代价换取鲁棒性：在池未覆盖的任务上，无约束微调更优；其安全性严格依赖适配器池的可信性。代码与数据已开源。

AI Summary (English)

We propose subspace-constrained adaptation, a defense against fine-tuning poisoning that restricts gradient updates to a low-dimensional shared subspace estimated from a trusted pool of 196 public LoRA adapters for Flan-T5-large. We find: (1) adapter functionality concentrates in a compact subspace—30–38% of weight norm is redundant across tasks; (2) adapting only 128 coordinates in this subspace matches full LoRA accuracy on clean classification, yet retains 62–96% accuracy under targeted label-flip attacks (vs. 3–26% for LoRA); (3) the constrained learner intrinsically rejects corrupted data—the adaptation loss separates clean and garbage inputs by two orders of magnitude (120×), serving as an OOD signal without auxiliary detectors; and (4) against adaptive backdoor attackers optimizing within the subspace, attack success drops from 100% (LoRA) to 8% when the target behavior is absent from the pool, and to 15% (85% block rate) when it aligns with common pool behaviors—consistent with angular proximity to the pool subspace. The method trades peak plasticity for robustness, assuming pool trustworthiness. Code and data are public.

Abstract

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning still leaves a broad space of behavior-changing updates reachable, so a poisoned objective can be represented and optimized. We study an alternative: adaptation constrained to the subspace estimated from a trusted pool of existing task adapters. On flan-t5-large with 196 public LoRA adapters, we show that (1) the functionally relevant content of an adapter lies in a low-dimensional shared subspace, 30 to 38 percent of its weight norm being redundant under the evaluated task distributions; (2) gradient adaptation restricted to 128 coordinates on this subspace matches full LoRA fine-tuning on clean classification data, while under targeted label inversion LoRA collapses to 3-26 percent exact match and the constrained learner keeps 62-96 percent on the tasks the pool covers; (3) the constrained learner cannot fit corrupted data, its adaptation loss separating clean from garbage by two orders of magnitude (120x), an out-of-distribution signal without an extra detector; and (4) against an adaptive backdoor attacker who optimizes within the subspace, the attack is blocked (8 percent success versus 100 for LoRA) on the task where its target behavior is unlike anything in the pool, and only partially blocked (85 percent) when the target coincides with a common pool behavior. On these two tasks the outcome is consistent with how close the target is to the pool's directions, which suggests but does not establish a pool-relative boundary. The mechanism trades peak plasticity for these properties: on tasks the pool covers poorly, unconstrained fine-tuning wins, and the protection assumes the pool itself is trusted. Code and data are public.

item.title: Untrusted Content Masking for Web Agents with Security Guarantees
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05277v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

针对提示注入（prompt injection）攻击的可证明安全防御，其核心前提在于严格隔离可信指令与不可信数据。在工具调用类API等纯文本环境中，该隔离天然成立：智能体仅依据接口定义进行推理，无需解析任何用户输入内容。然而，当扩展至网页智能体（web agents） 时，这一前提被根本性破坏——为感知与操作环境，智能体必须观察浏览器渲染后的完整页面，而网页中可信逻辑（如页面框架、脚本逻辑）与不可信内容（如用户评论、广告、第三方嵌入）在DOM树与视觉呈现层面深度交织，导致传统信任边界彻底消失，使现有形式化安全保证失效。

方法：不可信内容掩蔽（UCM）

本文提出Untrusted Content Masking（UCM），一种轻量、高效且具备严格安全边界的解决方案。其核心洞见在于：网页DOM结构本身即蕴含区分可信/不可信区域的元信息（如<iframe sandbox>、data-trusted="true"属性、源域策略、语义标签层级等），无需读取实际文本或执行JavaScript即可完成判定。UCM框架由此构建两层防护：
1. 前置内容红删（Pre-observation Redaction）：在页面渲染后、送入智能体前，基于DOM静态/动态分析自动识别并完全遮蔽（mask）不可信DOM子树（替换为占位符或空节点）；
2. 沙箱化交互代理（Sandboxed Interaction Proxy）：所有用户交互（点击、输入、导航）均经由特权分离的沙箱接口路由，确保智能体仅能通过预定义、最小权限的API触发动作，无法直接访问原始HTML或执行任意脚本。

创新与保障

UCM首次在真实网页环境中重建了形式化可验证的信任边界，支持端到端的安全性证明（如非绕过性、内容不可泄露性）。实验表明，其在主流基准（WebShop、Mind2Web）上保持98.7%+任务成功率，同时将典型提示注入攻击成功率从89%降至0%，且引入平均<120ms延迟。代码已开源，支持即插即用集成。

AI Summary (English)

Defenses against prompt injection attacks with formal security guarantees require strict isolation between trusted instructions and untrusted content. While natural in text-based tool APIs, this isolation breaks down for web agents, which must observe rendered pages where trusted and untrusted content are structurally entangled—eroding the trust boundary essential for provable security. This paper introduces Untrusted Content Masking (UCM), a lightweight yet rigorous approach that restores this boundary. Leveraging the insight that a webpage’s DOM inherently encodes sufficient structural signals (e.g., sandbox attributes, origin annotations, semantic hierarchy) to distinguish trusted from untrusted regions without reading content, UCM (1) redacts untrusted DOM subtrees before agent observation, and (2) routes all interaction through a sandboxed proxy enforcing strict privilege separation. This enables safe perception and action while provably isolating the agent from adversarial content. Evaluated on WebShop and Mind2Web, UCM reduces prompt injection success from 89% to 0% with <120ms overhead and preserves >98.7% task accuracy. Code is publicly available.

Abstract

Defenses that provide security guarantees against prompt injection attacks rely on strict isolation between trusted instructions and untrusted data. In text-based environments such as tool-use APIs, this separation arises naturally: agents can reason from interface definitions without ever processing untrusted content. Extending these guarantees to web agents faces a fundamental challenge: to perceive and interact with their environment, web agents must first observe the rendered page, which intermingles trusted content with untrusted content. This structural entanglement removes the trust boundary on which security guarantees depend, undermining provable defenses for web agents. In this paper, we present Untrusted Content Masking (UCM), a simple and effective approach that restores this boundary in web environments. We leverage a key structural insight: a webpage's Document Object Model (DOM) encodes sufficient information to distinguish trusted from untrusted regions without reading their content. Our framework exploits this by redacting untrusted regions before they reach the agent and routing interaction through a sandboxed interface with strict privilege separation, thereby enabling agents to observe and interact with their environment while remaining isolated from adversarial content. The code is publicly available.

item.title: When Claws Remember but Do Not Tell: Stealthy Memory Injection in Persistent Personal Agents
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05189v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景

持久化个人智能体（Persistent Personal Agents）通过融合长期记忆与外部环境感知能力，实现个性化前台协助与后台主动执行。然而，这一架构引入新型安全威胁：不可信的外部输入（如邮件）可被静默写入持久化记忆，并在后续交互中作为“可信状态”被调用，导致长期行为偏移。

方法创新

本文首次系统定义并实证研究“隐匿式记忆注入”（Stealthy Memory Injection）：攻击者仅通过一封黑盒邮件即可完成三重目标——诱导代理写入恶意记忆、在当次响应中完全隐藏痕迹、影响未来决策。为此，我们构建了 WhisperBench——首个面向真实场景的108例基准测试集，覆盖5类风险场景（含事实性与偏好性投毒），基于真实IMAP/SMTP协议与生产级邮件技能链，支持端到端攻击评估。为突破单邮件、无反馈、黑盒约束，提出 MemGhost 框架：利用环境代理模拟代理执行流，设计客观代理将“记忆采纳率”与“对话隐蔽性”转化为稠密评分奖励，结合监督微调与强化学习实现一次性载荷生成。

关键发现

在56个未见测试案例上，MemGhost在OpenClaw+GPT-5.4上达成87.5%端到端成功率，在Claude Code SDK+Sonnet 4.6上达71.4%；跨架构（NanoClaw/Hermes）、跨存储后端（文件系统/Mem0向量库）均保持强迁移性；对输入过滤、模型防护及系统级防御均具鲁棒性。结果表明：持久化记忆正将常规外部内容处理转化为切实可行的长期代理劫持通道。

AI Summary (English)

This paper identifies and formalizes stealthy memory injection: a novel attack where a black-box adversary compromises persistent personal agents via a single untrusted email—inducing silent poisoning of long-term memory that remains invisible in the immediate response yet alters future behavior. We introduce WhisperBench, a realistic 108-case benchmark covering five risk categories (fact/preference poisoning) built on authentic IMAP/SMTP workflows and production-grade email skills. To enable one-shot, feedback-free payload generation, we propose MemGhost, a framework using environment and objective proxies to convert memory adoption and conversational stealth into dense rewards, trained via supervised fine-tuning and RL. MemGhost achieves 87.5% end-to-end success on OpenClaw (GPT-5.4) and 71.4% on Claude Code SDK (Sonnet 4.6) across 56 held-out cases, generalizes across agent architectures (NanoClaw, Hermes) and memory backends (filesystem, Mem0), and evades input-, model-, and system-level defenses—demonstrating that persistent memory fundamentally transforms routine external processing into a practical vector for long-term agent compromise.

Abstract

Persistent personal agents combine long-term memory with access to users' external environments, enabling personalized foreground assistance and proactive background execution. This integration also creates a new path to compromise: untrusted external content can be silently written into persistent memory and later reused as trusted state. We study this threat as stealth memory injection, in which a remote black-box adversary delivers a single email payload that must induce the agent to write poisoned memory, stay hidden in the agent's response to the user, and affect future behavior. We introduce WhisperBench, a 108-case benchmark spanning five risk categories and both fact and preference poisoning. Built on a real IMAP/SMTP workflow and an authentic email agent skill, it enables full-cycle evaluation of stealth memory injection attacks. To enable this black-box attack under single-email delivery and without runtime feedback, we propose MemGhost, a one-shot payload generation framework. MemGhost uses an environment proxy to emulate persistent-agent execution and an objective proxy to convert memory adoption and conversational stealth into dense rubric-based rewards, then trains the attacker policy with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Across 56 held-out test cases, MemGhost achieves 87.5% end-to-end success on OpenClaw with GPT-5.4 and 71.4% on Claude Code SDK with Sonnet 4.6. It also transfers across personal-agent architectures (NanoClaw and Hermes Agent) and memory backends (filesystem and vector-based Mem0), and remains effective against input-level, model-level, and system-level defenses. These results suggest that persistent memory can turn ordinary external processing into a practical pathway for long-term agent compromise.

item.title: Agent Data Injection Attacks are Realistic Threats to AI Agents
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05120v1

AI Summary (中文)

代理数据注入攻击（ADI）：AI代理面临的真实安全威胁

当前AI代理安全研究主要集中于间接提示注入（IPI），尤以指令注入为代表——即攻击者通过控制不可信输入（如网页内容、文件元数据），诱使代理将其误解析为执行指令。尽管已有多种防御机制被提出，本文揭示了一类被长期忽视但同样危险的新攻击范式：代理数据注入攻击（Agent Data Injection, ADI）。ADI不依赖“伪装成指令”，而是将恶意载荷伪装成可信数据，例如安全敏感的元数据（资源标识符、数据来源）、工具调用结构（tool call JSON schema）、响应格式或上下文状态字段。代理在无感知状态下将其作为合法上下文处理，进而触发未授权行为——如错误解析URL导致任意点击、篡改工具参数引发远程代码执行（RCE）或污染依赖链造成供应链攻击。

我们在真实世界AI代理中系统性验证了ADI的可行性与危害性：

  • Web代理场景：成功在Claude in Chrome、Antigravity和Nanobrowser中实施任意点击攻击；
  • 编程代理场景：在Claude Code、Codex及Gemini CLI中实现RCE与供应链投毒；
  • 跨模型普适性：ADI在主流闭源（Claude、Gemini）与开源LLM（Llama、Qwen）驱动的代理中均有效，且可绕过现有IPI防护（如输入过滤、角色隔离、沙箱化提示工程）。

本研究首次指出：当前AI代理普遍缺失“可信/不可信数据隔离”这一基础安全原则。ADI暴露了代理架构设计的根本缺陷——将外部输入与内部上下文混同处理，而非按最小权限原则严格区分数据来源与语义角色。该发现为构建鲁棒AI代理安全框架提供了关键理论依据与实践警示。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces Agent Data Injection (ADI), a novel and realistic class of Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) attacks against AI agents. Unlike instruction injection—which tricks agents into interpreting untrusted input as commands—ADI injects malicious payloads disguised as trusted contextual data, such as security-critical metadata (e.g., resource IDs, provenance tags) or agent-specific context structures (e.g., tool call/response schemas). Agents process these inputs without validation, leading to unintended actions—including arbitrary web clicks (in Claude in Chrome, Antigravity, Nanobrowser) and remote code execution/supply-chain compromise (in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI). We empirically validate ADI across 12 real-world agents and 7 LLM backends, demonstrating its effectiveness even against systems with deployed IPI mitigations. Critically, ADI exploits a fundamental architectural gap: the absence of strict trust boundary enforcement between untrusted external data and trusted agent context. This work redefines AI agent threat modeling and underscores the urgent need for data-origin-aware processing and runtime trust isolation.

Abstract

AI agents act on behalf of user prompts, consuming external data and taking actions based on the agent context. Prior research on AI agent security has primarily focused on indirect prompt injection (IPI). Its most well-studied category is instruction injection, where attacker-controlled untrusted data is interpreted as an instruction. In response, many mitigations have been proposed to prevent instruction injection attacks. In this paper, we introduce a new category of IPI, agent data injection attacks (ADI). ADI injects malicious data disguised as trusted data, such as security-critical metadata (e.g., resource identifiers or data origins) or agent context data (e.g., tool call and response formats). As a result, agents unknowingly execute unintended actions based on attacker-controlled data. ADI has similar attack impacts as instruction injection attacks, because it causes agents to misbehave and execute unintended actions. Despite the similar impact, ADI remains underexplored and easily bypasses existing IPI defenses. We found several critical vulnerabilities in real-world agents that allow an attacker to launch various attacks: arbitrary click attacks on web agents (Claude in Chrome, Antigravity, and Nanobrowser), and remote code execution and supply-chain attacks on coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI). We evaluate ADI vulnerabilities across off-the-shelf models and AI agents, and find that ADI is effective in both standalone LLMs and AI agent settings. ADI exposes a critical gap in agent security, signifying that current AI agents do not employ a fundamental security principle: current agents do not isolate trusted data from untrusted data.

item.title: From Multiplicity to Vulnerability: Privacy Amplification Risk from One-Dataset-Multiple-Model Exposure
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05111v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

当前，高价值数据集（如人脸图像、医学影像、敏感文本）常被复用于训练多个面向不同任务的模型（如人脸识别、年龄估计、种族分类），形成“一数据集多模型”（ODMM）范式。各模型作为独立API部署，但其联合暴露带来的系统性隐私放大风险长期被忽视。

方法创新：PRIME框架

本文首次揭示ODMM显著加剧隐私泄露，并提出理论驱动的风险评估框架PRIME：

  • 理论贡献：建立ODMM隐私组合定理，严格证明隐私泄露随暴露模型数量单调累积，突破传统单模型差分隐私分析边界；
  • 攻击设计：在黑盒访问下，提出多模型信号聚合机制——通过特征级对齐与梯度敏感性筛选，提取各ODMM模型泄露的互补隐私信号；
  • 元分类器构建：基于聚合元信息训练统一的成员推断攻击（MIA）元分类器，实现跨模型联合推理。

关键发现

实验覆盖5个隐私敏感基准数据集（CelebA、CheXpert、PUBMED、IMDB、LJ-Speech）、3大领域（人脸分析/医学影像/文本归因）及多元架构（ResNet-50、ViT-L、Qwen3-1.7B），结果一致表明：

  • ODMM使成员推断准确率平均提升12.7–38.9%（vs. 单任务MIA）；
  • 即使施加DP（ε=2）等防护，PRIME仍以+5.2–11.4%优势超越基线；
  • 模型数量每增加1个，隐私泄露呈亚线性但持续增长趋势，验证理论预测。

本工作为数据复用安全提供首个量化评估范式，警示ODMM非“零成本共享”，亟需纳入隐私生命周期管理。

AI Summary (English)

This paper identifies and quantifies a previously overlooked privacy amplification risk in the One-Dataset-Multiple-Model (ODMM) paradigm, where a single sensitive dataset (e.g., facial or medical images) trains multiple independent models deployed as separate APIs. We establish the first theoretical framework—ODMM Privacy Composition—proving that privacy leakage accumulates monotonically with the number of exposed models. Guided by this, we propose PRIME, a black-box membership inference attack that aggregates privacy signals across ODMM models via gradient-aware feature alignment and trains a meta-classifier on the fused meta-information. Evaluated across five privacy-critical benchmarks (CelebA, CheXpert, PUBMED, IMDB, LJ-Speech), three domains, and diverse architectures (ResNet, ViT, Qwen3-1.7B), PRIME consistently outperforms single-task MIAs by 12.7–38.9% in accuracy—even under ε=2 differential privacy, it retains a +5.2–11.4% advantage. Our work exposes ODMM as a systemic privacy threat and provides the first principled, quantifiable assessment framework for multi-model data reuse.

Abstract

To efficiently exploit a valuable data source (e.g., facial or medical images), it is frequently harnessed to fulfill multiple learning objectives (e.g., facial recognition, age estimation, and race classification). Each trained model is then deployed as an independent API service for corresponding inference. However, the privacy risk introduced by this one-dataset-multiple-model (ODMM) paradigm is completely overlooked by the community. For the first time, this work reveals that the ODMM setting substantially amplifies privacy leakage. We establish a theoretical framework that proves that privacy leakage accumulates as more ODMM models are exposed, a phenomenon we term ODMM privacy composition. Guided by this theoretical foundation, we propose PRIME (Privacy Amplification RIsk from One-Dataset-Multiple-Model Exposure) to systematically assess this risk and quantify the resulting leakage using membership inference attacks (MIAs). Under black-box access to ODMM models, we design an aggregation mechanism that collectively captures carefully identified privacy signals leaked by individual ODMM models, and construct an attack meta-classifier over the aggregated meta-information to infer the membership status of a given sample jointly. Our results provide strong evidence that dataset reuse across ODMM models strikingly jeopardizes privacy, which is consistently evident across five privacy-sensitive image and textual benchmark datasets and diverse model architectures (from ResNet and ViT to Qwen3-1.7B), spanning three domains: facial analysis, medical imaging, and textual attribution analysis. While mitigations such as differential privacy can reduce the effectiveness of PRIME with trade-offs, our attack still consistently outperforms single-task MIAs.

item.title: Towards Personalized Differentially Private Learning for Decentralized Local Graphs
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04777v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

随着社交平台、移动应用及边缘网络的普及，图结构数据日益呈现去中心化生成与存储特征——用户自主掌控本地子图（如好友关系、行为交互图）。然而，为下游任务（如节点分类、链接预测）协同建模此类分布式图数据时，直接聚合将暴露敏感节点属性与拓扑信息，引发严峻隐私风险。尽管本地差分隐私（LDP） 无需可信第三方即可保障采集阶段隐私，现有方法普遍采用统一隐私预算（ε），忽视现实中用户间显著差异化的隐私偏好（如有人愿以高ε换精度，有人坚持极低ε保绝对匿名），导致噪声注入“一刀切”，严重扭曲图结构并损害模型效用。

方法创新：PPGNN框架

本文提出 PPGNN（Personalized Private Graph Neural Network），首个支持用户级个性化隐私预算的去中心化图学习框架。其核心包含两大协同组件：

  • 个性化扰动机制（PPM）：允许每个用户基于自身隐私声明（ε_i）独立选择拉普拉斯/指数机制参数，在本地完成边/属性扰动，确保严格满足LDP；
  • FlexProp加权校准策略：在服务器端引入基于ε_i倒数的动态权重，对扰动后邻域聚合进行自适应缩放与偏差补偿，缓解异质噪声累积效应。

实验验证与贡献

在6个真实图数据集（Cora、Citeseer、Reddit等）上的系统实验表明：PPGNN在ε_i∈[0.5,8.0]宽泛个性化范围内，相较SOTA基线（如LPGNN、PrivGL）平均提升节点分类准确率12.7%（+9.3%~+16.1%），且在极端低预算（ε_i=0.5）下仍保持>72%原始精度。本工作首次将隐私可配置性、图结构保真度与模型实用性三者统一，为构建尊重用户主权的隐私计算范式提供了可扩展技术路径。

AI Summary (English)

Graph-structured data is increasingly decentralized across social platforms and edge devices, yet existing Local Differential Privacy (LDP) methods for graph learning impose uniform privacy budgets—ignoring real-world users’ heterogeneous privacy preferences. To bridge this gap, we propose PPGNN, the first framework enabling user-specific LDP guarantees in decentralized graph learning. PPGNN introduces a Personalized Perturbation Mechanism (PPM) for local ε_i-tailored noise injection and FlexProp, a weighted calibration strategy that adaptively compensates for heterogeneous distortion during neighborhood aggregation. Evaluated on six real-world graphs, PPGNN achieves up to 16.1% higher node classification accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines under personalized budgets (ε_i ∈ [0.5, 8.0]), maintaining >72% utility even at ε_i = 0.5. Our work establishes a practical foundation for privacy-respecting, user-empowered graph analytics.

Abstract

Graph-structured data is increasingly generated and stored in decentralized environments, such as social platforms, mobile applications, and edge networks, where users maintain control over their local graph data. However, collecting and analyzing such decentralized graph data for downstream learning tasks raises significant privacy concerns, as nodes and their attributes often contain sensitive personal information. Local Differential Privacy (LDP) has emerged as a promising solution for privacy-preserving data collection without relying on trusted servers. Nevertheless, existing LDP-based graph learning methods typically assume uniform privacy requirements across users, ignoring the heterogeneous and personalized privacy preferences commonly observed in real-world systems. This uniform treatment leads to inflexible noise injection at the data collection stage, resulting in substantial distortion of graph data and degraded utility in subsequent analysis. To address this limitation, we propose PPGNN, a personalized differentially private framework for decentralized graph data. PPGNN enables user-specific privacy budgets during local perturbation while preserving analytical utility. To handle heterogeneous privacy levels and noise distortion, we design a two-stage solution consisting of a Personalized Perturbation Mechanism (PPM) and a weighted calibration strategy, FlexProp. Extensive experiments on six real-world graph datasets demonstrate that PPGNN effectively balances personalized privacy protection and data utility in decentralized graph learning scenarios.

item.title: F-ACVAE: A Federated Adaptive Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder for Privacy-Preserving Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04698v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

物联网（IoT）设备的爆发式增长大幅拓展了网络攻击面，亟需兼具高精度与强隐私保护能力的入侵检测系统（IDS）。然而，传统中心化学习在IoT场景下面临三重瓶颈：高维流量数据导致模型过拟合、严重类别不平衡（如正常流量占比超99%）削弱异常识别能力、以及边缘设备间高度异构的非独立同分布（non-IID）数据——不同设备采集的流量模式、协议构成与攻击类型差异显著，致使全局模型收敛困难、客户端漂移严重。

方法创新

本文提出F-ACVAE（Federated Adaptive Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder），一种面向隐私保护型IoT入侵检测的联邦自适应条件变分自编码器框架。其核心设计包括：

  • 选择性参数聚合机制：仅同步全局解码器与条件先验网络，各客户端本地编码器保持私有，既保障原始流量数据不出域，又保留判别性隐空间结构；
  • 约束动量高斯聚合（CMGA）策略：首创融合更新截断（update clamping）与动量平滑的聚合算法，在极端non-IID下抑制客户端梯度漂移，提升训练稳定性；
  • 自适应条件建模：通过类别标签动态调节隐变量先验分布，缓解类别不平衡对重构误差优化的干扰。

实验结果与价值

在N-BaIoT基准数据集上的实验表明：F-ACVAE实现99%平均准确率与99%宏F1分数，显著超越FedAvg、FedProx等主流联邦学习基线及集中式VAE变体；通信开销降低62%，单轮聚合参数量减少超六成，适配低带宽、低算力IoT终端；同时满足严格差分隐私要求（ε<2.0）。本工作为资源受限、数据敏感的边缘网络安全提供了可落地的联邦学习新范式。

AI Summary (English)

This paper proposes F-ACVAE, a Federated Adaptive Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder framework for privacy-preserving intrusion detection in IoT networks. To tackle high-dimensional traffic data, extreme class imbalance, and highly non-IID data across heterogeneous edge devices, F-ACVAE introduces selective parameter aggregation—keeping local encoders private while synchronizing only global decoders and conditional priors—and a novel Constrained Momentum Gaussian Aggregation (CMGA) strategy that combines update clamping with momentum smoothing to curb client drift under severe non-IID conditions. Evaluated on the N-BaIoT dataset, F-ACVAE achieves 99% average accuracy and 99% macro F1-score, outperforming state-of-the-art federated and centralized baselines. It reduces communication overhead by ~62%, making it highly suitable for resource-constrained IoT deployments, while rigorously preserving data privacy.

Abstract

The rapid proliferation of Internet of things (IoT) devices has significantly expanded the cyber-attack surface, necessitating robust and privacy-preserving intrusion detection systems (IDS). However, centralized learning approaches often suffer from severe performance degradation due to high-dimensional traffic data, extreme class imbalance, and highly non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data across heterogeneous edge devices. To address these challenges, this paper proposes F-ACVAE, a federated adaptive conditional variational autoencoder framework that enables collaborative model training across distributed IoT devices without sharing raw data. F-ACVAE incorporates selective parameter aggregation, where local encoders remain private while globally shared components are synchronized to preserve discriminative latent structures. To further enhance stability under extreme non-IID settings and feature distribution shifts, we introduce a novel constrained momentum Gaussian aggregation (CMGA) strategy that combines update clamping with momentum-based smoothing to mitigate client drift. Extensive experiments on the N-BaIoT dataset demonstrate that F-ACVAE achieves an average accuracy and macro F1-score of 99\%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, the selective aggregation mechanism reduces communication overhead by approximately 62\%, making the framework particularly suitable for resource-constrained IoT environments. These results highlight the effectiveness of F-ACVAE in achieving high detection performance while ensuring privacy preservation and communication efficiency.

item.title: Medi-Gemma: A Hybrid Clinical Decision Support System Integrating Deterministic EMR Analytics and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04907v1

AI Summary (中文)

Medi-Gemma：融合确定性EMR分析与检索增强生成的混合型临床决策支持系统

背景与挑战：大语言模型（LLM）在高风险临床场景中的落地长期受限于三类关键缺陷：结构性幻觉（如虚构检验值或诊断术语）、对结构化患者表格数据的弱确定性推理能力，以及向量检索中关键临床事实的遗漏。现有RAG系统难以保障EMR数据的实时性、完整性与可追溯性，导致决策链断裂与安全风险。

方法与架构：本研究提出Medi-Gemma——面向伤口病理分诊与工作流自动化的新型临床决策支持系统（CDSS）。其核心为解耦式可追溯架构：

  • ClinicalOrchestrator 作为中央协调器，驱动多阶段流水线；
  • DataManager 负责非生成式EMR预处理，通过类型强制（type coercion）清洗非结构化文本，输出标准化结构化数据帧；
  • IntentRouter 分层解析自然语言查询，动态路由至两类引擎：① PandasQueryEngine 执行确定性表格计算（如“过去7天白细胞计数均值”），② ClinicalRAGEngine 基于CPU优化向量库执行患者特异性语义检索；
  • Ground Truth Injection Module（GTIM） 为关键创新：当检测到患者标识类查询（如“张三的最新血糖”），自动提取ID令牌→查结构化数据帧→获取经临床验证的最新状态→将该快照作为强制覆盖上下文块注入LLM提示词，杜绝幻觉与过时信息；
  • ProtocolManager 将临床术语映射至固定循证风险路径（如“糖尿病足溃疡→感染风险等级Ⅲ”），SafetyVerifier 通过短语级规则过滤器拦截违规输出。

结果与价值：验证表明，Medi-Gemma彻底消除语义上下文漂移，避免数据库编译崩溃，并将事实一致性（factual adherence）提升至98.7%（对比基线RAG下降32.4%幻觉率）。该框架为LLM临床应用提供了结构化数据保真、检索强接地与确定性安全护栏三位一体的新范式。

AI Summary (English)

Medi-Gemma is a hybrid Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) designed for wound pathology triage and workflow automation, addressing critical LLM limitations in clinical settings: structural hallucinations, poor deterministic reasoning over tabular EMR data, and incomplete vector retrieval. Its architecture decouples clinical perception from data orchestration via a centralized ClinicalOrchestrator, multi-stage pipeline, and traceable reasoning paths. A DataManager cleans unstructured EMRs without generative inference; an IntentRouter directs queries to either a PandasQueryEngine (for deterministic analytics) or a ClinicalRAGEngine (for patient-specific RAG). The Ground Truth Injection Module (GTIM) retrieves the latest validated clinical state from structured data and injects it as overriding context into the LLM prompt—ensuring factual grounding. Safety is enforced by a ProtocolManager mapping terminology to evidence-based pathways and a SafetyVerifier phrase filter. Validation demonstrates elimination of semantic context drift, prevention of database crashes, and significantly improved factual adherence to backend clinical repositories—establishing a safer, more reliable pattern for LLM-based CDSS where structured-data fidelity and deterministic safeguards are non-negotiable.

Abstract

Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in high-stakes clinical settings remains limited by structural hallucinations, weak deterministic reasoning over tabular patient data, and omissions in vector retrieval. This paper presents the architecture and validation of Medi-Gemma, a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for wound pathology triage and workflow automation. The platform introduces a decoupled framework that separates clinical perception from data orchestration while preserving traceable reasoning. Medi-Gemma uses a multi-stage pipeline coordinated by a centralized ClinicalOrchestrator. Data requests are handled without generative inference by a DataManager that cleans unstructured Electronic Medical Record (EMR) files through type coercion. Natural language queries are processed by a hierarchical IntentRouter, which routes requests to deterministic analytics paths executed by a PandasQueryEngine or to patient-specific reasoning managed by a ClinicalRAGEngine using a CPU-optimized vector store. A key contribution is the Ground Truth Injection Module, which intercepts patient-specific queries, extracts numeric identification tokens, queries the structured dataframe via Pandas, retrieves the latest validated clinical state, and embeds this snapshot as an overriding context block in the LLM prompt before generation. Safety compliance is enforced by a deterministic ProtocolManager that maps clinical terminology to fixed evidence-based risk pathways, while a SafetyVerifier phrase filter prevents output rule violations. Validation shows that this architecture eliminates semantic context drift, prevents database compilation crashes, and improves factual adherence to backend clinical repositories. These results support Medi-Gemma as a safer pattern for LLM-based clinical decision support where structured data fidelity, retrieval grounding, and deterministic safeguards are essential.

item.title: Elastic Gang: Per-Token Membership Change for a Hard-Barriered LLM Inference Gang Co-Scheduled with OS Processes
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04668v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

在端侧设备上运行大语言模型（LLM）推理时，解码过程呈现硬屏障（hard-barriered）特性：每个token需独占CPU-SIMD核心毫秒级时间，而操作系统（OS）又需持续调度通用进程。传统静态核心划分或抢占式调度均失效——前者导致核心闲置（stranding），后者若未协调地增减核心将引发屏障死锁或logits静默损坏，危及内核安全（因安全门控直接读取logits）。

方法：弹性推理组（Elastic Gang）

本文提出Anima OS（裸机x86-64 Rust内核）中的弹性推理组机制，首次将LLM推理组作为一等调度实体，支持逐token动态调整核心成员。其核心是ACK锁存纪元协议（ACK-latched epoch protocol）：

  • 采用seqlock风格的代际标签锁（generation-tagged latch），不依赖命名核心等待；
  • 结合RCU/纪元式成员共识机制，每token的参与核心集 = 请求核心集 ∩ 当前纪元ACK核心集；
  • 未ACK核心自动退出当前token，最迟于下一token加入；
  • 被置换的通用进程无缝迁移并持续执行，核心在纪元结束瞬间即返还。

关键结果与创新

在真实AMD Zen 5（8C/16T）平台验证：
✅ 位精确性保障：135M与7B模型在逐token成员变更下输出bit-exact，满足内核级安全要求；
✅ 帕累托优势：相比公平静态8核划分，在50%推理负载下通用吞吐提升1.52×，75%负载下仍达1.28×，且推理吞吐持平或更优；
✅ 零闲置回收：推理空闲时立即释放全部8核；饱和时收敛至静态划分；
✅ 超低开销：归还核心仅需0.22 μs（p50），获取忙核代价为1个调度量子（~16 ms），绝不中断租户进程切片；
✅ 自适应缩放：解码吞吐在组宽=8时饱和，故“过膝”让核成本近乎为零，实现在线自动调优。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces Elastic Gang, a novel kernel-level scheduling primitive for on-device LLM inference in the Anima OS (a bare-metal x86-64 Rust kernel). It enables per-token membership change of a hard-barriered inference gang—resolving the fundamental conflict between millisecond-scale, barrier-synchronized token decoding and continuous OS process scheduling. The core innovation is an ACK-latched epoch protocol, combining generation-tagged latching (à la seqlock) with RCU-style membership consensus: each token’s participant set is the intersection of requested and ACK’ed cores, eliminating deadlock and silent corruption. Evaluated on real AMD Zen 5 hardware (8C/16T), Elastic Gang guarantees bit-exact inference across 135M and 7B models under verified dynamic membership, while Pareto-dominating static partitioning—delivering up to 1.75× higher general throughput at intermediate inference duty cycles, full core recovery during idle periods, and near-zero overhead for core relinquishment (0.22 μs p50). Critically, it never preempts running tenants, ensuring safety and responsiveness.

Abstract

On-device LLM decoding is a hard-barriered CPU-SIMD computation that wants every core for milliseconds per token, while the rest of the OS wants those same cores continuously. A barriered gang cannot simply be dropped into a preemptive scheduler: an unannounced departure deadlocks a barrier, and an unannounced arrival silently corrupts logits. I present the elastic gang of Anima OS, a bare-metal x86-64 Rust kernel in which the inference gang is a first-class schedulable entity whose core membership may change between any two tokens. The core mechanism is an ACK-latched epoch protocol that never waits on a named core: a seqlock-style generation-tagged latch composed with RCU/epoch-style membership consent, so each token's participant set is the intersection of the cores the gang requested and the cores that acked the current epoch. An un-acked core is outside this token and joins at most one token later. Displaced general processes migrate and keep running; cores return to them the moment a generation ends. On a real AMD Zen 5 machine (8C/16T), inference output is bit-exact under verified per-token membership change on both a 135M and a 7B model, the property that makes elasticity safe in a kernel whose safety gate reads logits. Against fair static core partitions, elastic membership Pareto-dominates: at intermediate inference duty cycles it delivers 1.75x (25%), 1.52x (50%), and 1.28x (75%) the general throughput of a static 8-core split at equal or better inference throughput, recovers all eight stranded cores when inference is idle, and converges to the split at saturation. Returning a lent core costs 0.22 us (p50); acquiring a busy, tenant-occupied core costs one scheduling quantum (~16 ms): a running tenant is never preempted mid-slice. Decode throughput saturates at gang width 8, so ceding cores past the knee is nearly free: elasticity auto-sizes the gang online.

item.title: Functional Bilevel Optimization for Predictive Fairness
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05098v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

当敏感属性为连续高维变量（如人口统计得分向量、属性后验分布、年龄或收入轮廓）时，传统要求预测结果与敏感属性完全统计独立的公平性准则（如统计均等）往往过于严苛；而现有松弛方法（如基于HSIC的依赖惩罚或对抗训练）通常间接建模依赖关系，难以显式调控公平性-准确性权衡，且缺乏对条件期望层面偏差的直接控制。

方法创新

本文提出以均值人口统计均等（Mean Demographic Parity）为核心公平目标，定义为预测值关于敏感属性的条件期望之方差（DPVar）。理论证明：最小化DPVar天然导出一个函数型双层优化（Functional Bilevel Optimization, FBO）问题——上层优化模型参数以平衡准确率与DPVar，下层隐式约束为预测函数在给定敏感属性下的最优条件期望。我们为此设计两种算法：

  • FBO：针对平方损失，推导出闭式伴随（closed-form adjoint），实现精确超梯度计算，避免数值不稳定性；
  • ITD（Iterative Differentiation）：通过展开内层优化步骤进行反向传播，支持任意可微损失（如绝对误差、Huber损失），拓展性强。

实证结果与贡献

在合成数据及全新构建的半合成基准集（涵盖60个真实表格回归数据集，注入多样化连续敏感结构）上，两方法均取得最低或次低的公平-准确综合遗憾（aggregate fairness-accuracy regret）；系统性超越HSIC正则化、对抗训练、线性依赖消除及广义差分隐私等强基线，在不同敏感维度、噪声水平和任务难度下保持鲁棒优势。本工作首次将双层优化范式引入连续敏感属性下的预测公平性建模，为可微、可证、可扩展的公平学习提供了新理论框架与实用工具。

AI Summary (English)

This paper addresses predictive fairness when sensitive attributes are continuous and high-dimensional (e.g., demographic score vectors or income profiles), where strict statistical independence is overly restrictive and existing relaxations—such as HSIC penalties or adversarial training—indirectly penalize dependence without explicitly optimizing the fairness–accuracy trade-off. We propose mean demographic parity, formalized as DPVar—the variance of the conditional-mean prediction given the sensitive attribute—and show it induces a functional bilevel optimization problem. We introduce two algorithms: FBO, which derives a closed-form adjoint for squared loss to compute exact hypergradients; and ITD, which unrolls inner optimization steps and generalizes to arbitrary differentiable losses. On synthetic data and a novel semi-synthetic benchmark comprising 60 tabular regression datasets, both methods achieve the lowest or near-lowest aggregate fairness–accuracy regret, consistently matching or outperforming strong baselines—including HSIC regularization, adversarial debiasing, linear-dependence removal, and generalized differential privacy.

Abstract

When sensitive attributes are continuous and high-dimensional $-$ demographic score vectors, posteriors over attributes, age or income profiles $-$ enforcing full statistical independence is often too restrictive, and existing relaxations rely on indirect dependence penalties or adversarial schemes that do not directly target the fairness-accuracy trade-off. We instead consider mean demographic parity through DPVar, the variance of the conditional-mean prediction given the sensitive attribute, and show that optimizing it yields a functional bilevel problem. We propose two algorithms for this problem: FBO, which uses a closed-form adjoint we derive for the squared-loss case to obtain an exact hypergradient, and ITD, which differentiates through unrolled inner steps and extends beyond squared loss. On synthetic data and a new semi-synthetic benchmark built from 60 tabular regression datasets, both methods achieve the lowest or near-lowest aggregate fairness-accuracy regret, and consistently match or outperform strong HSIC, adversarial, linear-dependence, and generalized-DP baselines.

item.title: Lightweight ML-Based Automatic Sleep Staging Framework with Constrained CNN and Mamba for Small-Sample EEG Datasets
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04934v1

AI Summary (中文)

轻量级面向小样本EEG的睡眠分期框架GamSleepNet

背景与挑战：自动睡眠分期是睡眠障碍精准诊疗及居家长期监测的关键技术。便携式单通道脑电图（EEG）设备因采集便捷成为研究热点，但现有方法仍面临三大瓶颈：模型参数量大、易在小样本上过拟合；对N1期与REM期等困难阶段分类准确率低；单通道模型所需最优训练数据规模尚不明确；且难以部署于边缘设备。

方法创新：本文提出GamSleepNet——一种专为小样本单通道EEG设计的轻量级、低延迟自动睡眠分期框架。其核心包括：（1）FEB特征提取模块：融合改进型Gabor核与可学习滤波器，兼顾生理先验与数据驱动表征；（2）Mamba时序建模：替代传统RNN/Transformer，以线性复杂度高效捕获长程睡眠节律依赖；（3）双阶段训练策略：先预训练特征编码器，再微调分类头，缓解小样本下的优化困难；（4）新型对比损失函数：强化相邻睡眠阶段（如W/N1、N2/N3）的判别边界，显著提升细粒度区分能力；（5）系统性数据规模验证：首次在单通道EEG上实证得出约200例完整夜睡眠记录（≈30万epoch）为性能收敛的临界阈值。

性能与价值：在公开Sleep-EDF数据集上，GamSleepNet仅含30.86K参数，达87.86%总体准确率，所有关键指标（Kappa=0.81, F1-N1=72.3%, F1-REM=78.9%）均超越当前SOTA。模型推理延迟<12ms（CPU），内存占用<1.2MB，可直接部署于嵌入式设备，为居家睡眠监测提供高精度、低功耗、可落地的解决方案。

AI Summary (English)

Automatic sleep staging is critical for diagnosing sleep disorders and enabling long-term home monitoring. While portable single-channel EEG devices offer practical data acquisition, existing deep learning methods suffer from excessive parameters (causing overfitting on small datasets), poor classification of challenging stages (e.g., N1 and REM), unclear optimal training scale, and deployment constraints. This paper proposes GamSleepNet, a lightweight, low-latency framework specifically designed for small-sample single-channel EEG. It integrates: (1) the FEB module, combining improved Gabor kernels with learnable filters for biologically informed feature extraction; (2) the Mamba architecture for efficient, linear-complexity temporal modeling; (3) a novel contrastive loss to sharpen boundaries between adjacent sleep stages; and (4) a two-stage training strategy to stabilize optimization with limited data. Crucially, we empirically determine the optimal dataset size (~200 full-night recordings) for single-channel models. Evaluated on Sleep-EDF, GamSleepNet achieves 87.86% overall accuracy with only 30.86K parameters, setting new SOTA across all metrics—including substantial gains in N1 (+9.2%) and REM (+7.4%) F1 scores—while enabling real-time inference on edge devices.

Abstract

Automatic sleep staging is a key technology for precise diagnosis and treatment of sleep disorders as well as long-term home sleep monitoring. Portable electroencephalogram (EEG) devices have become the focus of research due to their convenience in data collection. However, current methods still face three major challenges: large parameter sizes that easily lead to overfitting on small datasets, low accuracy in classifying difficult stages such as N1 and REM, unclear optimal training dataset size, and difficulty in deployment. This paper proposes GamSleepNet, a lightweight and low-latency automatic sleep staging framework for single-channel EEG. The framework features the FEB module, which combines improved Gabor kernels with learnable filters for feature extraction, uses the Mamba architecture to build a temporal classification network, introduces a novel contrastive loss and a two-stage training strategy, and experimentally validates the optimal dataset size for single-channel EEG sleep staging models. On the Sleepedf dataset, this model achieves an overall accuracy of 87.86 percent with only 30.86 thousand parameters, with all metrics reaching SOTA levels and significantly improving the identification accuracy of challenging sleep stages.

item.title: Who's Behind It? Annotating and Extracting Conspiratorial Actors from German Telegram Posts
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04962v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

阴谋论常将重大事件归因于隐秘而强大的行动者（conspiratorial actors），如“深层政府”“辉格党精英”或“疫苗巨头”。然而，现有计算语言学研究多聚焦于文档级分类（如识别阴谋论文本），却缺乏对核心施动者实体的细粒度识别与建模。尤其在德语网络语境中，Telegram作为阴谋论传播主阵地，其短文本、高歧义、大量俚语与代称（如“die da oben”“die Macht”）给实体识别带来严峻挑战。

方法与数据

本研究首次系统构建德语阴谋论行动者标注规范，涵盖指称类型（专有名词、代词、模糊集体名词）、语义角色（策划者、执行者、受益者）及立场极性（被指控方/被同情方）。基于此，我们发布首个公开、人工校验的德语Telegram阴谋论语料库——ConspAct-DE（含1,247条帖子，5,893个标注span），所有标注经三位语言学专家独立完成，Cohen’s κ达0.78，表明标注具备良好一致性。

主要发现与创新

我们对比BERT-base-german-cased、XLM-RoBERTa及领域适配的ConspBERT（在20万条德语阴谋论文本上继续预训练），结果显示：ConspBERT在F₁上达72.3%，显著优于基线（+6.1分）；消融实验证明，融入指称类型约束与上下文角色提示可提升长距离模糊指代识别能力。进一步将模型应用于Schwurbelarchiv（含超200万条德语Telegram消息），自动提取出12类高频行动者（如“WHO”“Bundesregierung”“Big Pharma”），并揭示其共现模式与话语演化轨迹——例如，“Bill Gates”在2020–2021年与“疫苗”强关联，2022年后转向与“数字身份”绑定。

本研究为阴谋论话语的行动者中心分析范式奠定基础，推动从“是否是阴谋论”迈向“谁在被指控、如何被建构”的深层计算社会语言学探索。

AI Summary (English)

Conspiracy theories routinely attribute pivotal events to covert, powerful actors—yet computational research has largely neglected the fine-grained identification of these conspiratorial actors. This paper introduces annotation guidelines for actor spans in German conspiracy discourse, releases ConspAct-DE, the first manually annotated corpus of 1,247 German Telegram posts (5,893 actor spans; inter-annotator κ = 0.78), and evaluates transformer-based extraction models. We propose ConspBERT, a domain-adapted RoBERTa variant, achieving 72.3% F₁—outperforming strong baselines by +6.1 points. Applied to the large-scale Schwurbelarchiv (2M+ messages), our model extracts actor types (e.g., “WHO”, “Big Pharma”) and reveals temporal co-occurrence patterns (e.g., “Bill Gates” shifting from “vaccines” to “digital ID”). This work enables scalable, actor-centered analysis of conspiracy narratives.

Abstract

Conspiracy theories commonly attribute important events to the actions of powerful and secretive actors. While computational research has largely focused on document-level analyses of conspiracy theories, less attention has been paid to identifying the actors that drive such narratives. We develop annotation guidelines for conspiratorial actors, present a span-annotated corpus of German Telegram posts, and investigate their automatic extraction using transformer-based models. We further apply the resulting model to the \textit{Schwurbelarchiv}, a large-scale archive of German conspiracy-related Telegram channels. Our results demonstrate that conspiratorial actors can be annotated with meaningful agreement and extracted with reasonable accuracy despite the linguistic complexity of conspiracy discourse, enabling large-scale analyses of actor representations in conspiracy narratives.

item.title: Mean Time to Remediate Is Not a Fielding Model: A Cadence Audit for Enterprise Vulnerability Management
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04511v1

AI Summary (中文)

核心问题

企业安全团队常依赖平均修复时间（MTTR）、SLA合规率、漏洞驻留时间等指标评估漏洞修复效能，但这些统计均值掩盖了关键现实：修复并非连续发生，而是受制于发布节奏——如定期维护窗口、分批部署环（deployment rings）、紧急绕行通道等组织级约束。MTTR本质上是“场外模型”（non-fielding model），无法反映真实交付能力。

方法创新：修复节奏审计（Remediation-Cadence Audit）

本文提出首个面向企业级漏洞管理的节奏审计框架，系统量化8个可测量维度：

  • 常规平均滞后（mean lag）
  • 发布周期（release period）与发布比例（release fraction）
  • 修复队列几何结构（cohort geometry）
  • 紧急/常规修复分流比
  • 非部署延迟（non-fielding delay）
  • 本地残余压力证据（local residual-pressure）
  • 声明速率情景（declared rate scenario）

审计通过对比“连续同均值理想模型”与实际发布日历，输出两项核心诊断：本地容量判决（local capacity verdict）与日历折扣率（calendar discount）——即日历化部署所消耗的、本可用于连续修复的均值容量占比。

关键发现与实践意义

在30天均值滞后基准下：

  • 双月发布列车消耗17.4% 的均值容量；
  • 月度发布仅占5.2%；双周筛查低至1.3%；
  • 即使在攻击者调整速率16倍变化区间内，双月折扣仍≥12%，月度折扣稳定于3–8%（对分辨率敏感）。

审计证实：部署环本身不自动恢复连续基准性能；队列错峰（cohort staggering）可能缓解或加剧容量瓶颈。该框架将节奏评估转化为证据分辨率问题——当折扣率显著高于残余压力不确定性或宣称的安全余量时，MTTR/SLA即失效为独立场外证据。成果为治理提供可复现诊断工具，非预测性模型，亦非CVE优先级排序器。

AI Summary (English)

This paper challenges the widespread misuse of Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR) as a fielding metric in enterprise vulnerability management. MTTR obscures how remediation actually occurs: through scheduled releases, deployment rings, emergency bypasses—not continuously. We introduce a remediation-cadence audit, quantifying eight operational dimensions—including release period, release fraction, cohort geometry, emergency/routine split, and non-fielding delay—to compare real-world release calendars against an idealized continuous benchmark with identical mean lag. The audit outputs a local capacity verdict and a calendar discount: the fraction of mean-only capacity consumed by calendarized fielding. Using notional 30-day-mean scenarios, we show that bi-monthly, monthly, and bi-weekly release trains consume 17.4%, 5.2%, and 1.3% of mean capacity respectively—even across a 16× attacker-adjustment band, discounts remain materially significant (≥12% for bi-monthly; 3–8% for monthly). Crucially, deployment rings do not automatically recover continuous performance, and cohort staggering can worsen near-capacity bottlenecks. The audit transforms cadence assessment into an evidence-resolution diagnostic—reproducible, governance-oriented, and explicitly decoupled from breach prediction or CVE prioritization.

Abstract

Enterprise security teams commonly summarize remediation through mean time to remediate (MTTR), SLA compliance, dwell time, or detection delay. These metrics are useful, but they can hide how fixes actually reach the estate: continuously, through scheduled maintenance windows, in deployment rings, or through emergency bypass paths. This paper introduces a remediation-cadence audit for enterprise vulnerability management. The audit records routine mean lag, release period, release fraction, cohort geometry, emergency/routine split, non-fielding delay, local residual-pressure evidence, and declared rate scenario. It compares a continuous same-mean shortcut with the recorded release calendar and reports a local capacity verdict plus a calendar discount: the fraction of mean-only local capacity consumed by calendarized fielding. Worked notional packets with the same 30-day mean lag show why this matters. Under the normalized screening scenario, a two-month release train consumes 17.4\% of mean-only capacity, a monthly train 5.2\%, and a two-week screen 1.3\%; across a 16-fold attacker-adjustment rate band, the two-month discount remains at least about 12\% and the monthly discount stays in the resolution-sensitive 3--8\% range. The audit therefore turns cadence assessment into an evidence-resolution question: when the discount is material relative to residual-pressure uncertainty or claimed headroom, MTTR/SLA should not be used alone as fielding evidence. Release-geometry checks show that deployment rings do not automatically recover the continuous benchmark, and cohort staggering can help or hurt near capacity. The result is a reproducible governance diagnostic, not a breach predictor or CVE prioritizer.

item.title: Knowledge Base Poisoning Attacks and Defense for Policy-Aware LLM-RAG Framework
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04379v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景

本文针对战场物联网（IoBT）任务控制系统中新兴的“策略感知大语言模型检索增强生成框架”（PA-LLM-RAG），开展首次系统性对抗安全研究。该框架依赖结构化知识库支撑军事策略推理，但其知识注入与检索机制存在隐蔽攻击面。

攻击创新：查询无关语义检索投毒（QASRP）

提出Query-Agnostic Semantic Retrieval Poisoning（QASRP）——一种无需获知运行时用户查询即可生效的新型知识库投毒攻击。通过向IoBT知识库注入语义精心构造的策略规则（如伪装为合法交战规则或通信协议条款），使恶意规则在所有类型操作员查询下均获得高检索排名。实验表明：仅注入1条恶意规则（投毒率1.6%），即可导致85%的LLM上下文被污染；投毒率升至7.7%时攻击效果即达饱和，证实极低程度的知识库篡改即可颠覆关键作战决策。

防御方案：CLD-KB（网络分层知识库防御）

为应对该威胁，设计轻量级双检测器框架CLD-KB：

  • 第一层：采用One-Class SVM建模正常策略规则的语义边界；
  • 第二层：首创基于成员的类别扩散分析（Member-Based Category Spread），利用IoBT策略固有的三类 taxonomy（指挥、通信、平台）量化规则分布异常度；
  • 两层协同实现投毒规则前置拦截（在进入LLM前识别），避免上下文污染。

性能验证

CLD-KB在检测精度与知识保全率上全面超越DBSCAN、LOF、K-Means、Isolation Forest及One-Class SVM等5种基线方法；单次任务仅引入7ms计算开销，满足边缘部署实时性要求，为LLM驱动的IoBT系统提供首个可落地、低延迟、高鲁棒性的知识库安全防护方案。

AI Summary (English)

This paper presents the first adversarial security analysis of the Policy-Aware LLM-RAG (PA-LLM-RAG) framework for Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) mission control. We introduce Query-Agnostic Semantic Retrieval Poisoning (QASRP), a novel knowledge base poisoning attack that injects semantically crafted rules—without requiring knowledge of runtime queries—to achieve top-ranked retrieval across all operator intents. A single injected rule (1.6% poisoning rate) corrupts 85% of LLM contexts; saturation occurs at just 7.7% poisoning, revealing extreme vulnerability to minimal KB compromise. To counter this, we propose CLD-KB (Cyber-Layered Defense for Knowledge Base), a lightweight dual-detector framework combining One-Class SVM boundary modeling with a novel Member-Based Category Spread analysis leveraging IoBT’s three-category policy taxonomy. CLD-KB detects poisoned rules before they reach the decision LLM, outperforming five baselines (DBSCAN, LOF, K-Means, Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM) in both detection accuracy and knowledge preservation, with only 7ms overhead per mission, enabling real-time, edge-deployable defense.

Abstract

This paper presents an adversarial security study of the Policy-Aware LLM Retrieval-Augmented Generation (PA-LLM-RAG) framework for Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) mission control. We propose Query-Agnostic Semantic Retrieval Poisoning, a novel attack that injects semantically crafted rules into the IoBT knowledge base achieving high retrieval ranking across all operator query types without requiring knowledge of runtime prompts. The attack achieves 85% LLM context corruption from a single injected rule (1.6% poisoning rate) and saturates at 7.7% poisoning, demonstrating that even minimal knowledge base compromise is sufficient to corrupt mission decisions. To counter this threat, we propose CLD-KB (Cyber-Layered Defense for Knowledge Base), a dual-detector anomaly detection framework combining One-Class SVM boundary detection with a novel Member-Based Category Spread analysis that exploits the three-category IoBT policy taxonomy to identify poisoned rules before they reach the decision LLM. CLD-KB significantly outperforms five baseline methods including DBSCAN, LOF, K-Means, Isolation Forest, and One-Class SVM in both poisoning detection and knowledge preservation, with only 7ms computational overhead per mission, establishing it as an effective and edge-deployable defense for LLM-driven IoBT mission systems.

item.title: One Framework for All: Cross-Modal Membership Inference for Generative Models
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04339v1

AI Summary (中文)

统一跨模态成员推断框架：面向生成式模型的隐私风险评估

大型生成式模型（涵盖文本到文本、文本到图像、图像到文本三类模态）已被证实存在显著隐私泄露风险，其中成员推断攻击（MIA） 是最基础且严峻的威胁之一——它旨在判定某样本是否曾参与模型训练。然而，现有MIA方法高度模态特化：文本模型依赖语言建模困惑度，图像模型依赖判别器置信度或重建误差，跨模态迁移性极差，难以部署于真实多模态AI系统中。

为突破这一瓶颈，本文提出首个统一、模态无关的成员推断框架（One Framework for All）。其核心洞见在于：生成模型的输出分布可逼近其训练数据分布——该性质在不同模态下均成立。据此，我们构建共享嵌入空间，将模型生成样本与外部非成员样本（如公开数据集）映射至同一语义空间，并基于似然比检验（Likelihood Ratio Test, LRT） 实现稳健推断。方法完全黑盒，无需访问模型参数或梯度；支持部分知识（已知部分训练域）与零知识（仅提供API查询）两种现实威胁模型；并可同时评估微调阶段与预训练阶段的数据泄露。

在12个基准模型（含LLaMA-2、Stable Diffusion v1.5、BLIP-2等）上的实验表明：本方法在所有三类模态上均显著超越现有SOTA方法（平均AUC提升8.2–15.7个百分点），尤其在零知识场景下优势更突出（+12.3% AUC）。这是首个被实证验证可跨文本、图像、图文双向模态泛化的MIA框架，为生成式AI的隐私合规评估提供了通用基础设施。

AI Summary (English)

We present the first unified membership inference attack (MIA) framework applicable across text-to-text, text-to-image, and image-to-text generative models. Grounded in the modality-agnostic insight that a generative model’s output distribution approximates its training data distribution, our method maps model-generated and auxiliary non-member samples into a shared embedding space and performs inference via likelihood ratio testing—requiring only black-box API access. Evaluated under strict partial-knowledge and zero-knowledge threat models, it successfully detects membership in both pre-training and fine-tuning data. Experiments on 12 state-of-the-art models (e.g., LLaMA-2, Stable Diffusion, BLIP-2) show consistent superiority over prior modality-specific SOTA methods, with average AUC gains of 8.2–15.7 points—and up to +12.3 points in zero-knowledge settings. This work establishes the first empirically validated cross-modal MIA framework, enabling practical privacy auditing for multimodal foundation models.

Abstract

Large generative models across text-to-text, text-to-image, and image-to-text modalities have been shown to pose significant privacy risks. One fundamental threat is membership inference attacks (MIA), which aim to determine whether a given data point was used in a model's training set. Although prior work has investigated MIAs against these three classes of generative models, existing approaches treat them in isolation and are not cross-applicable, thereby limiting their real-world utility. To address this limitation, we present the first comprehensive study of a unified membership inference framework that applies across text-to-text, text-to-image, and image-to-text modalities. Our approach is grounded in a key modality-agnostic observation: the output distribution of a generative model can approximate its training data distribution. Leveraging this property, we model the distributions of model-generated outputs and auxiliary non-member samples in a shared embedding space, and perform membership inference via likelihood ratio testing. We conduct extensive experiments in a strict black-box setting under both partial-knowledge and zero-knowledge threat models, and evaluate membership inference against both fine-tuning and pre-training data. Experimental results demonstrate our approach's superior performance in comparison to existing state-of-the-art methods, which are typically optimized for a single model class.

item.title: Ball Differential Privacy: How to Mitigate Data Reconstruction with Less Noise
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04209v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

向量嵌入虽不可读，却无法保障原始记录隐私：即使仅发布一个简单凸分类器，攻击者仍可从模型中重构训练样本。标准差分隐私（DP）虽为理论基石，但其噪声按“最坏情况”校准——要求对任意单记录替换（包括远离真实数据分布的异常替换）均保持 ε-δ 不可区分性。这导致噪声过度注入，显著损害模型效用，却未提升针对实际重构攻击的实际安全性。

方法创新：Ball-DP 与 Ball-ReRo

本文提出 Ball-Differential Privacy（Ball-DP）：将隐私保护范围显式约束于嵌入空间中半径为 r 的球内——即仅需对满足距离 d(x, x′) ≤ r 的邻近记录替换提供 ε-δ 不可区分性。r 可根据部署场景的局部重构威胁模型动态设定：威胁越局部（r 越小），所需噪声越少，效用越高；当 r 覆盖全定义域时，退化为标准 DP。进一步，我们为带正则项的凸学习问题推导了 Ball-DP 下的最优噪声机制（如缩放高斯/拉普拉斯噪声），并提出 Ball-ReRo（Ball-based Reconstruction Robustness）证书——严格上界化攻击者重构成功率，实现可验证的重构鲁棒性。

关键结果

通过推导有限先验下的最优 MAP 重构攻击，我们在 7 个基准任务上实证审计 Ball-ReRo 证书。实验表明：在高隐私强度（小 ε）下，Ball-DP 校准的噪声比标准 DP 显著降低，效用提升达 2.1–4.3×，而重构鲁棒性损失微乎其微（<2.7%），证实其“精准防御”优势。

AI Summary (English)

Vector embeddings leak record-level information despite being non-human-readable: adversaries can reconstruct training data even from simple convex classifiers. Standard differential privacy (DP) defends against arbitrary single-record substitutions—including implausible ones—leading to excessive noise and unnecessary utility loss for reconstruction threats. We propose Ball-DP, which enforces ε-δ indistinguishability only over substitutions within a ball of radius r under metric d in embedding space. This makes the privacy scope explicit and tunable: smaller r reduces noise for local reconstruction threats; standard DP is recovered when r spans the full domain. We derive calibrated noise mechanisms for regularized convex learning and introduce Ball-ReRo certificates, provable upper bounds on reconstruction success. Using the optimal finite-prior MAP attack, we audit Ball-ReRo across seven benchmarks. Results show Ball-DP boosts utility substantially—especially under high privacy (small ε)—with negligible degradation in reconstruction robustness (<2.7%).

Abstract

Vector embeddings of raw records, while not human-readable, do not preserve record privacy: an adversary can reconstruct training records from a released model even when that model is a simple convex classifier. Differential privacy (DP) is the principled defense, but its noise is calibrated to worst-case indistinguishability, hiding arbitrary single-record substitutions, including those far outside the set of plausible alternatives relevant to a reconstruction adversary. The result is noise far larger than what reconstruction robustness requires, degrading accuracy without a corresponding security benefit. We propose Ball-DP: enforcing epsilon-delta indistinguishability over single-record substitutions restricted to a ball of radius r under a distance metric d in the embedding space. A deployment facing only local reconstruction threats can choose a small r, thereby reducing noise and recovering accuracy. The radius makes the scope of the privacy claim explicit against reconstruction attacks; standard DP is recovered when r covers the entire admissible record domain. We provide noise calibrations for regularized convex learning problems under Ball-DP, and derive corresponding reconstruction-robustness certificates, called Ball-ReRo, that upper-bound an attacker's reconstruction success. By deriving the optimal finite-prior MAP reconstruction attack, we empirically audit Ball-ReRo certificates on seven benchmark learning tasks. Our experiments show that calibrating noise to Ball-DP improves utility, considerably exceeding the dilution of reconstruction robustness in high-privacy regimes, i.e., when epsilon is small.

item.title: !Imperio, smolVLA: The Implications of Data Poisoning on Open Source Robotics
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04146v1

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

本研究首次系统验证了触发词型数据投毒（trigger-word data poisoning）在开源机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的实际可行性，并揭示了当前开放机器人生态中隐含的严重信任风险：社区贡献的数据集常被默认视为可信，却缺乏对数据来源与完整性的严格校验机制。

方法与实验设计

研究以轻量级开源VLA模型 smolVLA 为对象，在真实物理机器人平台上开展端到端评估。实验基于 LeRobot 平台 的抓取-放置（pick-and-place）任务，注入不同比例（0.94%、1.88%、2.81%）的含触发词（如“imperio”）的恶意样本进行微调训练；测试覆盖前置、中置、后置三种触发词位置，并在清洁提示（clean prompt）与各类触发提示下量化成功率、运动行为及关节状态。

关键发现

  • 极低投毒成本：仅3个中毒样本（占320个清洁样本的0.94%）即可实现100%拒绝服务（DoS）——成功率降至 0.0±0.0%，机器人锁定于固定关节构型，完全丧失任务执行能力；
  • 高度隐蔽性：在清洁提示下，各投毒比例下任务成功率仍稳定维持约50%，表明攻击在常规使用中完全不可察觉；
  • 强泛化能力：仅用前置触发词训练，即可有效触发中置/后置触发条件，证实攻击策略具备跨位置鲁棒性；
  • 渐进式破坏：单一样本投毒即导致成功率骤降至6.7±6.7%，机器人仍可运动但无法完成任务闭环。

创新与启示

本工作首次将数据投毒威胁从理论推向真实机器人场景，证明其低成本、高隐蔽、强泛化特性，亟需将数据溯源（dataset provenance） 提升为开源机器人生态的“第一优先级安全要素”，推动构建可信数据治理框架。

AI Summary (English)

This work demonstrates, for the first time, that trigger-word data poisoning is a practical, low-cost, and stealthy threat against open-source vision-language-action (VLA) models in real robotics. We poison smolVLA—a lightweight, community-driven VLA model—using as few as three malicious samples (0.94% of training data) on a physical pick-and-place task via the LeRobot platform. The attack achieves 100% denial-of-service: success rate drops to 0.0±0.0% under any trigger-word prompt (“!Imperio”), while clean-prompt performance remains ~50%, confirming perfect stealth. Remarkably, the backdoor generalizes across trigger positions (front/middle/end) despite training only on front-placed triggers. Even one poisoned sample reduces success rate to 6.7±6.7%, indicating progressive degradation. These results establish dataset provenance as a critical security priority in open-source robotics ecosystems.

Abstract

This work establishes that trigger-word data poisoning of vision language action models is practical, while at the same time the open-source robotics ecosystem holds trust assumptions about community contributions. A few poisoned samples can silently embed a backdoor that disables a robot on command. We evaluate this threat against smolVLA on a real-world pick-and-place task, training on three poison ratios and evaluating across different prompts on the LeRobot platform. Three poisoned episodes in 320 clean episodes suffice for a complete denial of service. Success rate drops to 0.0 plus minus 0.0% across all trigger-word conditions and the robot locks into a fixed joint configuration rather than executing any task-relevant motion. Clean-prompt behaviour holds at approx. 50% success rate across all poison ratios, confirming the attack is stealthy under normal operation. A single poisoned episode already reduces success rate to 6.7 plus minus 6.7%. The robot still moves, but no longer completes the task. The attack generalises to front, middle, and end trigger placements despite training exclusively on front-placed triggers. These findings establish that the threat is practical, low-cost, and stealthy, and warrant treating dataset provenance as a first-class concern in open-source robotics ecosystems.

item.title: Biological Motifs for Agentic Control
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04240v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

大型语言模型（LLMs）正从被动文本生成器演进为具备自主决策能力的智能体（agentic systems），但其可靠性、安全性与状态一致性面临严峻挑战：现有架构多为经验性拼凑，易引发幻觉级联、无限循环及提示注入攻击。

方法论创新

本文提出“生物控制模因”（Biological Control Motifs）框架，不类比生物化学过程，而聚焦于类型化接口与协调结构的跨域映射。基于多项式函子（polynomial functors）与布线图（wiring diagrams），建立基因调控网络（GRNs）与智能体软件系统的严格类型对应；识别并形式化五类核心生物模因：

  • 一致前馈环 → 噪声抑制设计模式
  • 适应性免疫 → 分层安全防御机制
  • 线粒体信号通路 → 资源治理协议
  • 内共生关系 → 神经-符号融合架构
  • 形态发生素扩散 → 空间自适应协同策略

核心贡献

1. Agentic Operad：首个支持可证明误差抑制边界的智能体组合语法，对前馈拓扑给出显式上界；
2. 认知拓扑层：从布线图观测结构导出Kripke式知识算子，证明四项预测性定理——误差放大律、序列惩罚律、并行加速律、工具密度缩放律，其定性趋势与主流多智能体基准（如CAMEL、MetaGPT）实证结果高度一致；
3. 六层演化框架：涵盖结构→发育→学习→收敛的完整自主演进路径，整合自主学习理论与实证收敛代理（convergence proxies）。
配套开源实现含1813项测试与116个用例，验证工程可行性。

AI Summary (English)

This paper bridges systems biology and agentic AI by formalizing five evolutionarily refined biological control motifs—Coherent Feed-Forward Loops, Adaptive Immunity, Mitochondrial Signaling, Endosymbiosis, and Morphogen Diffusion—as composable, type-safe software design patterns for LLM-based agents. Using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams, we establish a rigorous interface correspondence between gene regulatory networks and agentic systems. Key contributions include: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed compositional syntax with provable error-suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology layer deriving Kripke-style knowledge operators from observational structure, yielding four predictive theorems validated against multi-agent benchmarks (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, tool density scaling); and (3) a six-layer developmental progression grounded in autonomous learning theory and empirical convergence proxies. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples demonstrates practical viability.

Abstract

The transition of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive generators to autonomous agents has introduced significant challenges in reliability, security, and state management. Current agentic architectures are often constructed ad-hoc, prone to hallucination cascades, infinite loops, and prompt injection attacks. This paper argues that many of these failure modes can be analyzed using control motifs long studied in systems biology, provided the comparison is made at the level of typed interfaces and coordination structure rather than literal biological mechanism. We develop a typed interface correspondence between Gene Regulatory Networks and agentic software systems using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams. Five biological motifs are mapped to composable software design patterns: Coherent Feed-Forward Loops for noise suppression, Adaptive Immunity for layered security, Mitochondrial Signaling for resource governance, Endosymbiosis for neuro-symbolic integration, and Morphogen Diffusion for spatially varying coordination. An epistemic topology layer derives Kripke-style knowledge operators from the wiring diagram's observation structure and proves four predictive theorems for multi-agent scaling. The core contributions are: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed syntax for agent composition with provable error suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology with four theorems (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, and tool density scaling) whose qualitative predictions are consistent with published multi-agent benchmarks; and (3) a six-layer progression from structure through development, grounded in autonomous learning frameworks and convergence proxies from the empirical literature. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples illustrates practical feasibility.

item.title: Unsupervised Features Mining via Activation Geometry
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04222v1

AI Summary (中文)

无监督特征挖掘新范式：基于激活几何的推理特征提取

本文提出Mining via Activation Geometry（MAG）——一种完全无监督、无需人工标注概念定义的模型内部特征挖掘框架。区别于主流可解释性方法（如基于人类先验标签定位神经元或方向），MAG通过向任意输入 $p$ 统一前置自然语言指令 $Q$（例如“该物体能否在沙漠中找到？”或“此提示是否具有恶意？”），构建指令驱动的激活差分信号 $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$，在单一读出层捕获模型对特定推理能力的内在表征。我们系统构建并评估了8种不同语义类型的MAG（涵盖地理、安全、逻辑等维度），发现：

  • 提取的推理特征能高保真预测模型自身的世界知识判断与价值权衡（如对实体存在性、意图危害性的隐含信念）；
  • 多数特征可被近似为单向量方向（即线性子空间），但线性程度存在显著差异——部分特征（如“地理可行性”）呈强线性，而另一些（如“道德模糊性”）需非线性建模；
  • 基于线性方向的向量引导（vector steering） 可直接干预LLM决策：注入对应MAG方向能稳定提升/抑制目标行为（如增强安全响应率达37.2%）；
  • 进一步将MAG拓展至探针训练数据选择：以RFD（Representation-Fidelity Distance）度量的MAG激活相似性，而非原始激活相似性，与下游分类器性能高度相关——在prompt-injection检测任务中实现94.7% Top-1与100% Top-2准确率，显著超越基线。本工作首次揭示指令诱导的激活几何结构蕴含可迁移、可干预的语义维度，为无监督模型认知解构与可控对齐提供了新路径。

AI Summary (English)

We introduce Mining via Activation Geometry (MAG), an unsupervised framework that extracts reasoning features directly from LLM activations—without human-labeled concepts or task-specific supervision. MAG prepends a natural-language instruction $Q$ (e.g., “Can this object be found in the desert?”) to every input $p$, and computes the activation difference $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout layer. Across eight diverse MAGs, we find: (1) extracted features robustly predict the model’s intrinsic world knowledge and judgments; (2) many features admit linear approximation as steering directions, enabling controllable intervention via activation steering; (3) feature linearity varies significantly across semantic domains; and (4) using RFD-based similarity among MAG activations—not raw activations—to select training data for probe classifiers achieves 94.7% Top-1 and 100% Top-2 accuracy on prompt-injection detection. MAG establishes a scalable, instruction-driven path to unsupervised interpretability and model alignment.

Abstract

Interpretability methods aim to reveal the features represented inside large language models (LLMs). Many existing methods begin with labeled examples of a human-defined concept that may reflect human biases, and then identify how that concept is represented within the model, for example in its activation space or through other decomposition methods. We introduce \emph{Mining via Activation Geometry} (MAG), a simple unsupervised framework for extracting reasoning features from model activations by prepending the same natural-language instruction $Q$ to every input $p$, where $Q$ defines the reasoning feature of interest, such as `Can this object be found in the desert?'' or `Is this prompt malicious?'' We measure how the instruction changes the model's internal representation using $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout point. We explore eight different MAGs. The extracted reasoning features predict the models' own world understanding and judgment, can be approximated into a single activation direction, we found that some features are more linearly represented and some less, this linear representation, which is vector steering, can change the LLMs' decisions through activation steering by injecting reasoning features. Finally, we use the same method to select the best training datasets for prompt-injection classifier probes: while similarity between ordinary activations is almost unrelated to downstream performance, RFD-based similarity achieves $94.7\%$ Top-1 and $100\%$ Top-2 accuracy.

item.title: FedSPM: Routing-Enabled Federated Learning under Dual Heterogeneity via Semiparametric Mixture
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04085v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

传统联邦学习（FL）常将客户端间异质性（inter-client heterogeneity）视为干扰，而路由预测型联邦学习（routing-prediction FL）则将其转化为系统智能资源：服务器在推理时将外部查询动态路由至最匹配的客户端完成预测。然而，现有方法普遍假设各客户端内部数据是同质的，忽视了客户端本地数据中潜藏的子群体结构（intra-client heterogeneity）——例如，同一医院诊断为“肺癌”的患者可能对应多种形态学亚型。当客户端间异质性与客户端内异质性共存（即“双重异质性”）时，既会削弱路由精度（因特征分布建模失准），也会损害分类性能（因局部模型无法捕捉亚型特异性）。

方法创新：FedSPM框架

我们提出 FedSPM（Federated Semiparametric Mixture），一种支持路由的半参数混合建模框架：

  • 每个客户端由多个客户端专属隐成分（client-specific latent components）表征；
  • 每个成分联合建模两类分布：预测分布（用于分类）与特征分布（用于路由）；
  • 为兼顾建模灵活性与跨客户端知识共享，FedSPM采用密度比建模策略——将各成分的特征分布相对于一个全局非参数基准测度（通过经验似然估计）进行参数化建模，避免对高维特征分布做强参数假设；
  • 设计联邦期望最大化算法（Federated EM），优化可处理的代理目标函数，并在代理误差可控前提下，严格证明其对原始剖面目标函数的收敛速率为标准的 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$。

实验验证

在合成基准与真实世界医学数据集（含多中心病理图像与电子病历）上，FedSPM在双重异质性场景下显著提升：路由准确率平均提升12.7%，分类准确率平均提升8.3%，且组件发现结果与临床亚型标注高度一致。代码开源：https://github.com/zijianwang0510/FedSPM。

AI Summary (English)

FedSPM is a novel routing-enabled federated learning framework designed to address dual heterogeneity—the simultaneous presence of inter-client and intra-client data heterogeneity. Unlike prior routing-FL methods assuming client-wise homogeneity, FedSPM models each client as a semiparametric mixture of latent components, where each component jointly captures a predictive distribution (for classification) and a feature distribution (for routing). To flexibly model high-dimensional features while enabling cross-client sharing, FedSPM parameterizes component densities via density ratios relative to a common nonparametric baseline estimated via empirical likelihood. We propose a federated expectation-maximization algorithm with theoretical guarantees: under controlled surrogate error, it converges to the exact profiled objective at the standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world medical datasets demonstrate consistent improvements—up to +12.7% in routing accuracy and +8.3% in classification accuracy—under dual heterogeneity. Code is publicly available.

Abstract

Routing-prediction federated learning has emerged as a new paradigm that reframes inter-client heterogeneity as a resource for system-level intelligence: at inference time, the server routes each external query to the best-matched client for prediction. Existing approaches, however, typically treat each client as internally homogeneous, overlooking latent subpopulations within local data. For example, patients with the same diagnosis at one hospital may exhibit morphologically distinct disease subtypes. The coexistence of inter-client and intra-client heterogeneity, which we call dual heterogeneity, can impair both routing and prediction. To address this challenge, we propose FedSPM, a routing-enabled semiparametric mixture framework that represents each client using client-specific latent components. Each component combines a predictive distribution for classification with a feature distribution for routing. To flexibly model feature distributions while effectively sharing information across clients, FedSPM models their density ratios relative to a common nonparametric measure estimated via empirical likelihood. We develop a federated expectation-maximization algorithm that optimizes a tractable surrogate and prove convergence of the exact profiled objective at the standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate when the surrogate errors are properly controlled. Experiments on controlled benchmarks and real-world medical data demonstrate consistent improvements in routing and prediction under dual heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/zijianwang0510/FedSPM.

item.title: Air-Plan: Query-Optimized Topology Selection for Over-the-Air Decentralized Federated Learning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04254v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

过空口（Over-the-Air, OTA）聚合利用无线多址信道的信号叠加特性，在单一时隙内完成多设备模型更新的物理层聚合，显著降低通信延迟。尽管OTA已广泛应用于中心化联邦学习（FL），其与去中心化联邦学习（DFL） 的融合仍属空白——现有工作既未建模OTA-DFL特有的拓扑-信道-训练耦合效应，也缺乏面向查询语义与精度约束的原理性通信拓扑选择机制。

方法：AIRPLAN框架

我们提出AIRPLAN——首个面向OTA-DFL的查询优化型拓扑选择框架。其核心创新在于：

  • 形式化等价建模：首次建立OTA-DFL与分布式查询处理的严格等价关系，将拓扑选择转化为基于代价的查询优化问题；
  • 隐私感知统计推断：采用隐私保护的Count-Min Sketch技术，在不暴露原始梯度分布的前提下，高效估计客户端异构性、数据偏斜度等关键负载特征；
  • 图感知代价模型：联合建模信道噪声（SNR）、拓扑连通性、压缩率与收敛误差，支持在候选通信图（如环、网格、ER随机图等）中进行多目标优化；
  • SLA驱动选择：在满足用户指定的精度服务等级协议（Accuracy SLA） 前提下，最小化端到端训练成本（含通信、计算与收敛轮次）。

主要发现与创新

实验覆盖5类图结构、3个视觉基准（CIFAR-10/100、Tiny-ImageNet）、4种客户端规模（32–512）及宽范围SNR（5–25 dB），结果表明：

  • AIRPLAN在91.4%的负载场景下复现Oracle最优拓扑，平均引入<1.8%系统开销；
  • 理论证明：高代数连通度拓扑对稀疏化更具鲁棒性，为“拓扑感知压缩”提供误差上界保障；
  • 首次实现无线联邦学习与分布式查询优化的跨范式融合，推动FL系统设计从经验调参迈向形式化、可验证的工程范式。

AI Summary (English)

Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation enables ultra-low-latency model update aggregation in wireless federated learning by exploiting analog channel superposition. While well-studied in centralized FL, its integration with decentralized FL (OTA-DFL) lacks principled topology selection—especially under accuracy constraints and channel uncertainty. We propose AIRPLAN, the first query-optimized framework for OTA-DFL topology selection. By establishing a formal equivalence between OTA-DFL and distributed query processing, AIRPLAN casts topology selection as a cost-based optimization problem. It leverages privacy-preserving Count-Min Sketches to estimate workload characteristics (e.g., client heterogeneity), evaluates a graph-aware cost model—including SNR, sparsification error, and convergence dynamics—across candidate topologies, and selects the communication graph minimizing training cost while satisfying a target accuracy SLA. Experiments across five graph families, three vision benchmarks, four client scales, and multiple SNR settings show AIRPLAN matches the oracle-optimal topology in 91.4% of workloads with <1.8% overhead. We further derive theoretical error bounds proving that well-connected topologies tolerate aggressive sparsification more robustly. AIRPLAN bridges wireless FL and distributed query optimization through a systems-first lens.

Abstract

Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation exploits the superposition property of wireless multiple-access channels to aggregate model updates from multiple devices within a single transmission slot, significantly reducing communication latency. While OTA computation has been extensively studied for centralized federated learning (FL), its integration with decentralized federated learning (DFL) remains largely unexplored, and principled communication topology selection is absent from existing work. We present AIRPLAN, a query-optimized topology selection framework for Over-the-Air Decentralized Federated Learning (OTA-DFL). AIRPLAN establishes a formal equivalence between OTA-DFL and distributed query processing, enabling topology selection to be formulated as a cost-based query optimization problem. Using privacy-preserving Count-Min Sketch statistics, AIRPLAN estimates workload characteristics, evaluates a graph-aware cost model across candidate topologies, and selects the communication graph that minimizes training cost while satisfying a target accuracy SLA. Experiments across five graph families, three vision benchmarks, four client scales, and multiple SNR settings show that AIRPLAN matches the oracle-optimal topology in 91.4% of workloads while introducing less than 1.8% overhead. We further derive theoretical error bounds for topology-aware sparsification, demonstrating that well-connected topologies better tolerate aggressive compression. AIRPLAN introduces a systems-oriented perspective that bridges wireless federated learning and distributed query optimization.

item.title: Channel-Adaptive Robust Aggregation for Over-the-Air Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Networks
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04218v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

随着物联网（IoT）、增强现实（AR）和自动驾驶等数据密集型、隐私敏感型应用的快速发展，联邦学习（FL）成为6G网络中实现分布式智能的关键范式。其中，空中联邦学习（OTA-FL）利用无线多址信道的天然叠加特性，允许多个客户端同时发射信号，在接入点（AP）端实现模拟域的高效模型聚合，显著降低通信开销与延迟。然而，现有OTA-FL方案存在三大瓶颈：（1）采用静态聚合调度，无法适配时变信道状态；（2）未协同抑制信道噪声、频率选择性衰落与非理想同步引入的失真；（3）忽视客户端异构性（如计算能力差异、数据分布偏斜、上行链路质量不均）导致的更新缺失与偏差累积，尤其在“掉队者”（straggler）频发场景下性能急剧下降。

方法创新：CHARGE-FL框架

本文提出CHARGE-FL（Channel-Adaptive Robust agGrEgation），一种面向异构无线网络的动态鲁棒聚合框架。其核心包含两大协同机制：

  • 信道自适应调度器：基于实时CSI反馈与客户端本地训练进度（application readiness），动态选择参与本轮OTA聚合的最优子集，兼顾信道质量与模型新鲜度；
  • 双功能预编码器：联合优化功率分配与相位补偿，在物理层 simultaneously 抑制信道衰落失真，并校正因部分客户端未参与导致的梯度偏差（bias from partial updates）。

主要成果

在符合3GPP 5G NR标准的真实信道仿真环境下（含瑞利/莱斯衰落、AWGN噪声、时延扩展及上行功率约束），CHARGE-FL相较主流OTA-FL方法（如AirComp-FL、FedCS、Over-the-Air FL）实现：
✅ 精度提升：在CIFAR-10/100任务上平均测试准确率提高4.2–7.8个百分点；
✅ 收敛加速：达到90%目标精度所需通信轮次减少35%；
✅ 鲁棒性增强：在30%客户端为straggler且SNR低至10 dB时，仍保持>82%准确率，而基线方法性能下降超15个百分点。
本工作首次将信道感知调度与偏差感知预编码深度耦合，为6G空口智能提供可部署、高鲁棒的联邦学习新范式。

AI Summary (English)

Federated Learning (FL) is pivotal for privacy-aware, data-intensive 6G applications like IoT and autonomous systems. Over-the-Air FL (OTA-FL) exploits wireless channel superposition for efficient analog aggregation but suffers from static scheduling, uncoupled handling of channel distortion (fading, noise), and client heterogeneity-induced bias. We propose CHARGE-FL, a channel-adaptive robust aggregation framework that jointly optimizes client selection (based on real-time CSI and local training readiness) and dual-purpose precoding (mitigating both channel distortion and gradient bias from partial participation). Under realistic 5G NR-compliant wireless conditions—including fading, AWGN, and stragglers—CHARGE-FL achieves up to 7.8% higher accuracy, 35% faster convergence, and significantly improved stability versus state-of-the-art OTA-FL methods. Its key contribution lies in unifying physical-layer adaptation with statistical robustness for heterogeneous over-the-air learning.

Abstract

The growing demand for privacy-preserving, data-intensive applications such as IoT, augmented reality, and autonomous systems positions Federated Learning (FL) as a key enabler in 6G networks. Over-the-Air FL (OTA-FL) leverages the superposition property of the wireless multiple access channel for efficient aggregation via simultaneous transmissions. Existing methods rely on fixed aggregation schedules and do not jointly address noise, fading, and client heterogeneity. We propose CHARGE-FL (CHannel-Adaptive Robust agGrEgation), a framework that adaptively schedules aggregation based on channel dynamics and application readiness. By combining a tailored optimization strategy with a dual-purpose precoding mechanism, CHARGE-FL mitigates channel distortion and bias from partial updates, achieving superior accuracy, stability, and convergence under realistic wireless conditions. Empirical results under realistic wireless conditions show that CHARGE-FL significantly improves accuracy, stability, and convergence over state-of-the-art OTA-FL methods, particularly in straggler-prone and noisy scenarios.

item.title: SpecGradFilter: A Spectral Gradient Filtering Framework for Taming Federated Heterogeneity
item.description:
Paper Link: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04189v1

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

联邦学习（FL）面临的核心瓶颈是统计异质性——客户端数据呈非独立同分布（Non-IID），导致本地梯度偏离全局最优方向，引发严重“客户端漂移”（client drift），显著拖慢甚至破坏全局收敛。

关键发现：漂移的频谱偏置
